item.title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.

item.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin, Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

item.title: US government grounds all flights across the United States ‘due to extraordinary circumstances’
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: A spokesperson for the FAA told TechCrunch that it issued the ground stop "following communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers," which manage the airspace across the United States.

item.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Drogue is harvesting heat from the ocean to power data centers on floating vessels. The first prototype should be bobbing around the ocean, crunching bits, in less than two years.

item.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

item.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.

item.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

item.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

item.title: Uber confirms hackers stole thousands of drivers’ license information in data breach
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The ridesharing giant said drivers' license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.

item.title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: ElevenAI is a new meeting notetaker and dictation app aimed at teams and enterprises.

item.title: Microsoft’s latest email outage turned into a full-blown global cloud crisis
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Microsoft's daylong outage began with Outlook and Teams and ended up taking much of the company's cloud services offline. Microsoft says it's gradually restoring service.

item.title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Given Nvidia’s stronghold on AI and its importance in Israel, many in the country's startup ecosystem are worried about the impact of his departure.

item.title: Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Huang described Kress as a "deer in the headlights" during a meeting in summer.

item.title: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation, write scathing letter on Huang’s ‘scheme’ with Trump
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: This Congressional investigation into Nvidia's China sales and its dealings with Trump is the second one, so far, since news of the alleged spy affair broke.

item.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses — but it's not free.

item.title: Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans, even as delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.

item.title: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.

item.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.

item.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.

item.title: Jensen Huang’s exit puts Nvidia’s support for open source in question
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation raises questions about Nvidia’s commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition, open-weight models, and advocacy against restrictions, as the company navigates a leadership transition.
